اذلعبوا (form IVq)
# اِذْلَعَبُّوا (iḏlaʕabbū) /ið.la.ʕab.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِذْلَعَبَّ (iḏlaʕabba)
# اِذْلَعِبُّوا (iḏlaʕibbū) /ið.la.ʕib.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِذْلَعَبَّ (iḏlaʕabba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
